text: `SuggestionsFor` examines each available child command and suggests its name when the case-insensitive Levenshtein distance is within `SuggestionsMinimumDistance`, when its name has the typed text as a case-insensitive prefix, or when the text case-insensitively matches an entry in `SuggestFor` (`command.go:831-851`). `findSuggestions` disables this entirely when `DisableSuggestions` is set and otherwise defaults a nonpositive distance threshold to 2 (`command.go:750-766`).
